hero.label: A private hilltop home in Comares, Andalusia
hero.subtitle: Named for the four winds that sweep its hilltop and keep the house cool all summer.

intro.title: A spectacular view all the way to the sea.
intro.text: Cuatro Vientos stands alone on its hill above olive and almond groves. From the shaded terrace, the pool and the garden, the view opens across the mountains of the Axarquía to the Mediterranean, and the hilltop catches both sunrise and sunset. A courtyard, objects from Ursula’s travels and space to linger make it a home to settle into.

area.title: The hills, the village, the sea.
area.text: Walk through the gate and follow a trail into the hills. Wander up to Comares for its whitewashed streets and village bars. Or take the car towards the coast, knowing the terrace will be waiting when you return.
area.caption: The hilltop village of Comares.

house.label: The house
house.title: A home with a story in every room.
house.intro: Built in Andalusian style and furnished by Ursula with pieces collected in South America, the house brings living spaces, bedrooms and terraces together around a private patio. The entire property is yours during your stay.
house.leadCaption: Shade on the covered terrace, with the Axarquía beyond.

living.title: The living room
living.text: Exposed wooden beams, terracotta floors and objects from Ursula’s travels give the living room its personal character. Gather around the wood-burning fireplace, settle into a chair with a book, or use the dining table for a board game. Doors open onto the front terrace, carrying everyday life outside.

kitchen.title: Cooking & gathering
kitchen.text: The kitchen is informal, rural and well equipped for cooking at home. An extendable table makes room for meals indoors; a few steps lead up to the covered terrace when you would rather eat outside. The pool and outdoor shower sit just beside it, so lunch and an afternoon swim are easily combined.

bedroomOne.title: The first bedroom
bedroomOne.text: The main bedroom has a double bed and two pull-out single beds tucked behind a screen, accommodating up to four guests in one room. A desk occupies a corner with a view. Air conditioning is charged according to use.

bedroomTwo.title: The second bedroom
bedroomTwo.text: A double bed and an additional single bed make space for three guests. There is a sitting corner, a view outside and access through the patio as well as the house. Air conditioning is charged according to use.

bathrooms.title: Two bathrooms
bathrooms.text: The first bathroom has a shower and toilet and is reached from the hallway near the living spaces. The second sits between the bedrooms and has a bathtub and toilet. Towels are provided.

patio.title: At the heart of the house
patio.text: The private inner courtyard brings the rooms together in the Andalusian tradition. Ochre walls, terracotta tiles, plants and collected details make it a place to pause: a few pages of a book, an unhurried conversation, another hour around the table.

outdoors.title: Terraces, pool & garden
outdoors.text: A small circular pool looks over the mountains towards the Mediterranean. Around the house, terraces offer different places to eat, sit and take in the views; beside the covered terrace is an outdoor shower. Beyond them, the large fenced garden has a hammock beneath an old holm oak.

comares.label: Comares & beyond
comares.title: A slower way into Andalusia.
comares.intro: Villa Cuatro Vientos stands in La Alquería, near the hilltop village of Comares. Olive groves and almond trees surround the house, with walking routes at the gate and the Mediterranean beyond the hills. A car is essential for exploring the wider area.
comares.leadCaption: The hilltop village of Comares at dusk.

village.title: The white village
village.text: Comares is within walking distance of the house. Follow ceramic footprints through its narrow streets, discover traces of its Moorish past and stop at a village bar or restaurant. Everyday life continues here around the bakery, small supermarket and village squares.
village.caption: A whitewashed street in Comares.

hills.title: Walk out into the hills
hills.text: Signposted trails begin just outside the gate, passing olive groves, almond trees and natural springs. The landscape is part of staying here: you can make a walk the day’s main event, then come home to the courtyard or a swim.
hills.caption: Looking back towards Comares from the hills.

sea.title: A day by the sea
sea.text: Torre del Mar, the nearest beach, is around 30 km from the house. Take a day for the seafront and fresh fish, or continue to Málaga for its museums, streets and Atarazanas market. The house gives you a quiet base inland, away from the busier coast.
sea.caption: A beach café on the coast.

further.title: Further afield
further.text: For a longer excursion, consider Granada and the Alhambra, Córdoba’s Mezquita, Ronda or the Caminito del Rey. El Torcal, Nerja and Lake Viñuela offer other ways to spend a day. Choose an outing that suits your pace and check the route before setting off.
further.caption: The Alhambra in Granada, with the Sierra Nevada behind.

around.title: Getting around.
around.text: Comares is a walk away. For the coast, the city and the wider Axarquía, you will want a car.

stay.label: Plan your stay
stay.title: Make yourself at home.
stay.intro: A private house for family and friends, with space to share meals and time outdoors. Here are the details to help you decide whether Villa Cuatro Vientos is right for your stay. Availability, prices and booking are handled through Airbnb.
stay.imageCaption: The patio: an intimate place to read, talk and linger.

arrival.title: Arrival & departure
arrival.text: Check-in is from 3:00 pm and check-out is by 10:00 am. You will be welcomed in person. Arrange arrival details with the hosts through Airbnb.

travel.title: Getting here & getting around
travel.text: A car is essential for exploring this part of Andalusia. There is free parking for three cars on the property. Comares is within walking distance; use the hosts’ directions for your arrival at the house.

comfort.title: Air conditioning & Wi-Fi
comfort.text: Both bedrooms have air conditioning, charged according to use. Wi-Fi is available free of charge throughout the house.

children.title: Staying with children
children.text: A travel cot, high chair, children’s books and toys are available on request. The seven sleeping places are shared across two bedrooms: one sleeps four and the other sleeps three.

pets.title: Bringing a pet
pets.text: Pets are welcome by prior arrangement and an additional charge applies. The property is fenced. Please discuss your pet with the hosts before booking.

booking.title: Your booking
booking.text: Check your dates on Airbnb for the current price and cancellation terms. You can also contact the hosts there with questions about the house or your stay.

book.title: Check your dates.
